description_en: Creates a scaling plan for an AnalyticDB for MySQL cluster
kebab_example: aliyun adb create-elastic-plan --elastic-plan-name test --resource-group-name test --start-time 2022-01-01T12:01:00Z --end-time 2025-01-01T12:01:00Z --enabled true --cron-expression 0_20_14_0_0_0 --target-size 32ACU --type EXECUTOR --auto-scale false --db-cluster-id amv-wz9509beptiz0000 --api-version 2021-12-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateElasticPlan

parameters.help_en:
The name of the scaling plan.

>  The name must be 2 to 30 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, and underscores (\_). The name must start with a letter
parameters.help_zh:
弹性计划名称。
> 弹性计划名称的长度为2～30个字符，以字母开头，且只能由字母、数字和下划线组成
parameters.name: elastic_plan_name

parameters.help_en:
The name of the resource group.

> 

*   If you want to create a scaling plan that uses interactive resource groups, you must specify this parameter. If you want to create a scaling plan that uses elastic I/O units (EIUs), you do not need to specify this parameter.

*   You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/459446.html operation to query the resource group name for a cluster
parameters.help_zh:
资源组名称。

>- 如果需要创建弹性资源类型为Interactive资源组的弹性计划（即计算资源类型的弹性计划），必须指定资源组名称。如果需要创建弹性资源类型为查询存储加速服务（EIU）的弹性计划，无需指定资源组名称。
- 调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/459446.html接口可以查看指定集群的资源组名称
parameters.name: resource_group_name

parameters.help_en:
The start time of the scaling plan.

>  Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end time of the scaling plan.

>  Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to immediately enable the scaling plan after the plan is created. Valid values:

*   true
*   false
parameters.help_zh:
创建后是否立即启用弹性计划。
取值说明：
- true：立即启用。
- false：不启用
parameters.name: enabled

parameters.help_en: A CORN expression that specifies the scaling cycle and time for the scaling plan
parameters.help_zh:
Cron表达式，表示弹性计划的变配周期和变配时间。

>Type参数取值为EXECUTOR时，该参数必填
parameters.name: cron_expression

parameters.help_en:
The desired specifications of elastic resources after scaling.

> 

*   If the scaling plan uses **EIUs** and **Default Proportional Scaling for EIUs** is enabled, you do not need to specify this parameter. In other cases, you must specify this parameter.

*   You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/601278.html operation to query the specifications that are supported for scaling plans
parameters.help_zh:
目标规格。
> - 只有弹性资源类型为**存储加速服务弹性计划**并且启用了**存储加速服务(EIU)按比例默认弹性**，可以不填写该参数。其它情况下，该参数为必填项。
> - 调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/601278.html接口可以查看弹性计划支持的弹性变配规格
parameters.name: target_size

parameters.help_en:
The type of the scaling plan. Valid values:

*   EXECUTOR: the interactive resource group type, which indicates the computing resource type.
*   WORKER: the EIU type
parameters.help_zh:
弹性计划类型。
取值说明：
- EXECUTOR：Interactive资源组，即计算资源类型。
- WORKER：存储加速服务（EIU）
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable **Default Proportional Scaling for EIUs**. Valid values:

*   true. In this case, storage resources are scaled along with computing resources, and the TargetSize and CronExpression parameters are not supported.
*   false

> 

*   This parameter must be specified when Type is set to WORKER. This parameter is not required when Type is set to EXECUTOR.

*   You can enable Default Proportional Scaling for EIUs for only a single scaling plan of a cluster
parameters.help_zh:
是否启用**存储加速服务(EIU)按比例默认弹性**。
取值说明：
- true：启用。启用后，存储资源会跟随计算资源的弹性伸缩而伸缩，且不支持填写目标规格和Cron表达式。
- false：不启用。
>- Type为WORKER时，本参数必填。Type为EXECUTOR时，本参数不填。
> - 整个集群只支持启用一个存储加速服务(EIU)按比例默认弹性的存储弹性计划，启用了此类型的弹性计划以后，无法再启用其他的存储弹性计划
parameters.name: auto_scale

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.

>  You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454250.html operation to query the IDs of all AnalyticDB for MySQL clusters within a region
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。
> 调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454250.html接口查看集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id
